dedupe_keys.name: us county unweighted daily heat metrics 2000 2020

description: The Heatmetrics research team publishes unweighted daily county heat indicators for the contiguous United States over 2000–2020. Variables include minimum, maximum and mean temperature, dewpoint, humidex, heat index, net effective temperature, wet-bulb globe temperature and UTCI. The own page provides an RDS download readable with readRDS and states CC BY 4.0, with free access. These aggregates can support sensitivity checks in county heat-exposure simulations and comparison with data-era5-reanalysis. A caveat is that unweighted does not mean every grid cell in a county: only pixels with non-zero populations contribute, excluding areas such as large inland waterbodies. Monroe County, Florida, and Nantucket County, Massachusetts, are also missing. This resource therefore differs both from a full-land-area average and from the separate population-weighted deposit. Users must choose the aggregation that matches their simulated exposure. No county values were downloaded.
